messages:
Elliot (eng-partnerships): FYI: We're planning to deprecate CUDA 11.8 on our marketplace images next month. Need a partner playbook for driver fallbacks & hotfix path. Ping @Priya to confirm HW testing windows. TL;DR: staged announcements + automatic routing to pinned driver variants if runtime detects regressions. Thoughts?

Priya (hw-partner): Thanks Elliot. We need at least 3 weeks for full kernel validation across our SKUs. Can we split deprecation into 'announce' -> 'soft-deprecate' -> 'enforce' phases? Also request: don't remove legacy packages from marketplace images until fallback is validated.

Marco (solutions): Agree on phases. For fallbacks, can we surface a `driver_compat` tag in marketplace metadata so runtime can auto-route? I'll add an integration test that runs `./ci/driver_compat_check.sh` matrix.

Samira (platform): We can implement a canary rollout policy in Console: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. We already have smart routing; suggestion: automatic rollback when error rate >2% OR median latency increases by +15%. I'll draft a rollout config snippet.

marketplace-bot: Event: Joint deprecation sync scheduled 2026-04-08 14:00 UTC — https://calendar.redwood.ai/ev/12345

Priya (hw-partner): Where do we drop hotfix binaries? Prefer S3 staging `s3://redwood-partner-hotfixes/priya/` or a package repo? Also we need checksum and signed manifest for verification.

Elliot (eng-partnerships): Use S3 + signed manifest. Marco, can you produce a minimal rollback image that pins the driver to 520.61? If the runtime detects a quant/regression we fallback to that image automatically.

Marco (solutions): Yes. I'll push an image and put a manifest at `s3://redwood-partner-hotfixes/marco/2111112222-manifest.json`. Sample pin command for runtime:

```
run --image=redwood/marketplace:rollback-520 --env DRIVER_PIN=520.61
```

Also creating CI job: `pipeline: driver-rollback-verify` to run the smoke + perf checks.

Samira (platform): Quick ops note: update release gates to require green kernel smoke + nvprof run before we move to 'soft-deprecate'. Ensure canary logs retained for 72h and exported to S3 for partner analysis.

Priya (hw-partner): :thumbsup: We'll schedule validation week Apr 13-17. Can someone assemble the partner-facing one-pager and the escalation phone tree?

Elliot (eng-partnerships): Onesheet & phone-tree: I'll draft. Include contacts: Priya (HW PM), Marco (Solutions), Samira (Platform), Eng-oncall. Also include instructions for partners to opt into the `legacy-driver` tag if they need more time.

Marco (solutions): I'll post the CI matrices and image links in meeting notes after the sync.

Elliot (eng-partnerships): Thanks everyone — unless there are blockers I'll send the announcement draft EOD. :sparkles:
